summary: All three deliverables fully meet the task's intent and the build is green. (A) The modal now has exactly 8 tabs in order Overview, Network, Console, Events, Errors, AI, Graph, Settings; the TabName union is widened and the TabContent switch has a Graph case. GraphTab renders a grouped-by-type list (fixed order screen/component/hook/service/store/api, zero-count types skipped, summary count card, per-node file path and dependencies) when non-empty, and the specified empty-state with the exact `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` command and the `AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(graph)` startup snippet plus a host-app footer note when getNodes().length === 0. (B) package.json maps bin.applens-index -> dist/ai/index-project-ast.js, version is unchanged at 0.3.2, no tag is on HEAD, both index-project wrappers remain, and the compiled CLI keeps its `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang and runs (prints a JSON array). (C) The AI-tab empty-graph hint is computed only after the `provider.isConfigured()` early-return (so it never appears on the SetupPrompt path) and only when getNodes().length === 0; GraphTab is exported from src/index.ts with no breaking changes to existing exports. Docs are consistent: README (8-tab intro, Graph table row, ASCII diagram, exports list), AI-INTEGRATION.md, and AI-SETUP.md all promote `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` as primary with the explicit node_modules/dist path kept as an alternative and host-app ./src emphasis, and CHANGELOG.md has a `## [Unreleased]` Added section with the three bullets and no version bump. `npm run type-check` and `npm run build` both exit 0, and dist/ is gitignored and not committed.
